records.title: Host
records.mission_label: A podcast on building a successful business as a solopreneur.
records.mission:
The concept:
Starting a business is not easy. Starting a business alone is even harder and it can often feel lonely in the process.
With SOLOS, we remind ourselves that there are many solo creators out there and we are no longer alone.
In this podcast, I'll discover how to create a successful business as a solopreneur, share my own solo creative journey, and hopefully make some friends along the way.
One episode every week.
https://solos.ventures
Background:
I created the concept from scratch by nesting as much as possible. I source the guest, and shoot the episodes, the rest I have an editor.
The stack:
- Rode wireless GO II
- Riverside FM
- Anchor
- youtube

records.title: CTO Associate
records.mission_label: Modern environment to migrate Excel financial files to python via jupyter.
records.mission:
The concept:
Create a modern environment as close as possible to the old Excel financial files to migrate them to python via jupyter and automate their workflow to apply the DRY principle (don't repeat yourself) to the world of finance.
Context:
CTO of CashStory I created and implemented the entire service galaxy of our financial data pipeline, all in docker and kubernet.
Our galaxy is more than 50 docker machines
The stack:
- JupyterLab increased by our library, which allows among other things to automate (CRON) and call notebooks via API
- FTP connected to Jupyter users controlled by house API
- BOB workspace which brings together all of our services and who knows how to chat with them on the front via secure message iframe or back via API, the workspace works LOGINLESS for the services that accompany it.
(Angular, .Net, mySQL)
- Wekan, to manage tasks on data workflow
- Filestash to access our ftp via web interface
- Graphana for internal metrics in the galaxy
- Mongo, prometheus, postgres, redis, snowflake for database
- Toucan toco to view data at the end of the chain
- Caddy server for SSL certificates and http / 2 by default

records.title: QA engineer
records.mission_label: First QA engineer — set up testing and test automation practices.
records.mission:
The concept:
Simply visualize your data in business with our data storytelling solution. Make informed decisions through our application, available on mobile, tablets and pc.
Context:
I joined Toucan Toco first engineer for quality assurance (QA), my goal was to set up, good practice of testing and test automation, it was a particular challenge because Toucan Toco is a fully configurable solution. This mission I failed, End-to-End testing, in a non-constant environment is a big challenge, in addition to the human challenge that it represents to engage people on in-depth testing.
I made the decision with them to end our trial period and advise them to empower each developer in this mission rather than appointing a manager, and this solution is still the one in place with them today.
The stack:
- End to End Test nightwatchjs
- Angularjs
- Docker
- vuejs
- Python
- CircleCI
- Ansible
